name: Angelic Being
description: You still terrify villagers but they are willing to speak to you. 40% higher prices on trades

actions.command: execute at @s as @e[type=villager,distance=..7] run data merge entity @s {Gossips:[{Target:[I;1,1,1,1],Type:'major_negative',Value:40}]}
execute at @s as @e[type=villager,distance=..7] run data modify entity @s Gossips[{Target:[I;1,1,1,1]}].Target set from entity @s UUID
